subject.title: No migration path or warning when a model provider id is removed/renamed (openai-codex -> openai): OAuth profiles silently orphaned

question: Should OpenAI/Codex migration guidance be handled by a revived narrow doctor diagnostic hint, folded into the broader shared migration-plan work, or closed once the Nix-mode guard fix makes the existing auth-profile migration reachable?
rationale: The existing repair path and docs reduce the original gap, but adding a blanket re-auth hint could contradict automatic migration, and the same-author Nix companion issue is still open.

options.title: Fold guidance into migration-plan work
options.body: Coordinate the operator wording with the shared legacy Codex migration plan and the Nix-mode guard fix before landing another narrow hint.

options.title: Revive the narrow hint
options.body: Open a small replacement PR that adds a carefully scoped doctor hint only when automatic profile migration cannot run or cannot repair the credential.

options.title: Close after Nix guard lands
options.body: If maintainers decide reachable `doctor --fix` plus existing docs fully solves this case, close this issue after the Nix-mode companion is resolved.

recommendation.title: Fold guidance into migration-plan work
recommendation.body: Coordinate the operator wording with the shared legacy Codex migration plan and the Nix-mode guard fix before landing another narrow hint.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the canonical OpenAI provider boundary and doctor migration policy introduced in steipete's provider identity unification work.
